note: TWENTY ONE TV followed-profile segment (App\Support\Caster\FollowedScripts): an intro naming the profile ({name}, nominative: the display name or 'ein Nostr-Kollege'; self_intros when the profile is Markus' own), then Markus' retelling and reaction by the league voice. When the voice is off or its draft fails a check, the attribution reads a short quote of the note and a reaction stands in. Reactions are opinion only: no facts, no names, no numbers, and they must fit any note.
